{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=July 2025}}
[[File:Amy Cohen-Corwin 1979.jpg|thumb|Cohen-Corwin in 1979]]

'''Amy Cohen-Corwin''' (formerly known as '''Amy C. Murray''') is a professor emerita of mathematics at [[Rutgers University]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Amy Cohen, also Amy Cohen-Corwin |url=https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~acc/ |access-date=2022-03-17 |website=sites.math.rutgers.edu}}</ref> and former Dean of University College at Rutgers University. In 2006, she was named [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Historic Fellows {{!}} American Association for the Advancement of Science |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic |access-date=2022-03-17 |website=www.aaas.org |language=en}}</ref>

Cohen-Corwin is especially interested in the [[Korteweg–de Vries equation]], cubic [[Schrödinger equation]] on the line, and improving undergraduate education, especially for future teachers.<ref>[http://www.math.rutgers.edu/~acc/ Amy Cohen, also Amy Cohen-Corwin<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> She worked on [[Project SEED]] whilst at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1970 which fueled her interest in [[Mathematics education]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.msri.org/|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|last=MSRI|website=www.msri.org|access-date=2019-04-16}}</ref>

Cohen-Corwin has held numerous organizational positions, including Co-organizer for the AIM ([[American Institute of Mathematics]]) and NSF ([[National Science Foundation]])-sponsored workshop "Finding and Keeping Graduate Students in the Mathematical Sciences."<ref>[http://www.aimath.org/~skrantz/Blurbs/attracting.html Finding And Keeping Graduate Students<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>

== Awards ==
*[https://awm-math.org/awards/hay-award/hay-award-2013/ Louise Hay Award] for Contributions to Mathematics Education, Joint Mathematics Meeting, [https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/ Association for Women in Mathematics]<ref>[https://awm-math.org/awards/hay-award/hay-award-2013/ Press Release: Amy Cohen honored with Hay Award]</ref> - 2013
*Fellow, [https://www.aaas.org/fellows American Association for the Advancement of Science], elected 2006<ref>[http://www.aaas.org/publications/annual_report/2006/aaas_annualreport06.pdf American Association for the Advancement of Science,  Annual Report (2006) (see page 23)] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100105072800/http://www.aaas.org/publications/annual_report/2006/aaas_annualreport06.pdf |date=January 5, 2010 }} (Accessed Oct 2010)</ref>
*Fellow, [https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/2019-awm-fellows/ Association for Women in Mathematics], 2019<ref>{{citation|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/|title=2019 Class of AWM Fellows|publisher=[[Association for Women in Mathematics]]|accessdate=2018-10-07}}</ref>

== Education ==
* Ph.D., 1970, Mathematics, [[University of California at Berkeley]], under the supervision of [[Murray H. Protter]]<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=32357}}</ref>
* M.S., 1966, Mathematics, University of California at Berkeley
* A.B., 1964, Mathematics, [[Harvard University]] ([[Radcliffe College]])<ref>[http://www.math.rutgers.edu/~acc/ShortVita.html Short Vita 2007<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>
